rules.nameZh: 敌人的能力值UP
rules.descriptionZh:
世界第一形态HP+230% / 第二形态HP+230%
昏厥抗性大幅提升且更难触发连锁时机
rules.descriptionEn:
The World's first form: HP +230%
The World's second form: HP +230%
Greatly boosts The World's resistance to stun, and link chances
are harder to trigger.

rules.nameZh: 精准格挡待诞可获得额外效果
rules.nameEn: Boosts effects of perfect guarding Quickening
rules.descriptionZh:
触发精准格挡时反弹的待诞命中时
造成高额昏厥伤害并触发连锁时机
同时赋予世界持续15秒的[世界裂痕]效果
效果期间世界受到的伤害+300%
rules.descriptionEn:
Reflecting Quickening with a perfect guard deals a massive
amount of stun on hit, triggers a link chance, and inflicts
Fractured World  to The World for 15 sec.
While in effect, The World takes 300% more damage.

rules.nameZh: 第二形态根据第一形态的持续时间获得强化
rules.descriptionZh:
任务开始100秒后世界仍处于第一形态时
世界获得[纯白之境]效果（最大Lv10）
此后第一形态每持续20秒提升1次该效果Lv
第二形态下世界攻击力根据效果Lv提升（最大+50%）
rules.descriptionEn:
After the first 100 sec., if The World is in its first form,
it gains a lvl of Proto-White World  (max lvl 10).
While in effect, it gains a lvl every 20 sec. until The World
transforms into its second form.
While in its second form, The World gains a max of ATK +50%
based on Proto-White World's lvl.

rules.nameZh: 阿卡姆卡牌获得强化
rules.descriptionZh:
世界召唤的阿卡姆卡牌HP+50%
阿卡姆系列招式发动前的准备时间缩短
rules.descriptionEn:
Arcarum cards: HP +50%
Arcarum special attacks now take less time to activate.

rules.nameZh: 世界的攻击造成的拉近效果获得强化
rules.nameEn: The pull of The World is more powerful
rules.descriptionZh: 世界攻击的拉近效果获得强化
rules.descriptionEn: The World's suction-type attacks pull with even greater force.

rules.nameZh: 敌人的能力值UP
rules.descriptionZh: 巴哈姆特·异型的HP+330% / 昏厥槽+70%
rules.descriptionEn: Bahamut Versa: HP +330% / Stun Gauge +70%

rules.nameZh: ？？？参战
rules.descriptionZh:
任务中会有神秘敌人[？？？]参战
击败？？？时己方全体获得紫银之炎
已有紫银之炎时不会因此发生爆炸
？？？会在被击败40秒后复活
rules.descriptionEn:
The mysterious ??? fights against you.
Upon defeating ???, the entire party is inflicted with
Darkflame . It won't cause an existing infliction of
Darkflame to explode.
??? revives after 40 sec.

rules.nameZh: 紫银之炎追加攻击性能强化的效果
rules.descriptionZh:
[紫银之炎]效果期间
赋予自身攻击造成伤害200%的追击效果
rules.descriptionEn:
While inflicted with Darkflame , your attacks gain
Supplementary DMG (200%).

rules.nameZh: 巴哈姆特·异型的攻击附带紫银之炎
rules.descriptionZh:
每次受到巴哈姆特·异型攻击
都会被赋予[紫银之炎]效果
但巴哈姆特·异型的攻击更难导致破防
rules.descriptionEn:
Bahamut Versa's attacks inflict Darkflame 
but won't break your guard as easily.

rules.nameZh: 紫银之炎的爆炸伤害大幅提升
rules.descriptionZh:
[紫银之炎]效果期间
再次获得[紫银之炎]效果
会发生爆炸并受到50000伤害
rules.descriptionEn:
While inflicted with Darkflame , the next infliction of
Darkflame triggers a big explosion that deals 50000 damage.

rules.nameZh: 敌人的能力值UP
rules.descriptionZh:
路西法的HP+250% / 昏厥槽+65%
终焉神器的HP+400%
rules.descriptionEn:
Lucilius: HP +250% / Stun Gauge +65%
Dark Opus swords: HP +400%

rules.nameZh: 自身陷入的弱化效果持续时间变化
rules.descriptionZh:
路西法和终焉神器赋予的
弱化效果持续时间+100%
角色攻击每次命中敌人时
可使自身的弱化效果持续时间-15%
基于攻击威力提升效果量
rules.descriptionEn:
Debuffs inflicted by Lucilius and his swords last 100% longer.
Whenever you land a hit, you recover 15% faster from debuffs.
The stronger the attack, the faster the recovery.

rules.nameZh: 路西法的攻击附带最大HP减少效果
rules.nameEn: Certain Lucilius attacks inflict Max HP↓
rules.descriptionZh:
每次受到路西法特定攻击
都会被赋予弱化效果[最大HP减少]（最大Lv5）
Lv随着时间经过而降低
rules.descriptionEn:
Some of Lucilius's special attacks also inflict a lvl of
Max HP↓  (max lvl 5). The lvl gradually lowers over time.

rules.nameZh: 攻击DOWN和防御DOWN的效果提升
rules.nameEn: ATK↓ and DEF↓ are more debilitating
rules.descriptionZh:
强化自身赋予的攻击DOWN和防御DOWN
效果量：攻击力-40% / 防御力-30%
强化路西法和终焉神器赋予的
攻击DOWN和防御DOWN
效果量：攻击力-30% / 防御力-20%
rules.descriptionEn:
When inflicted by you:
ATK↓  lowers ATK by an additional 40%
DEF↓  lowers DEF by an additional 30%
When inflicted by Lucilius and his swords:
ATK↓  lowers ATK by an additional 30%
DEF↓  lowers DEF by an additional 20%

rules.nameZh: 路西法的部分攻击获得强化
rules.descriptionZh:
最后抗争或绝对虚无效果范围内
追加强大的持续伤害效果
失乐园准备阶段会产生落雷
rules.descriptionEn:
AoE pools spawned by Final Rebellion and Absolute Nothing
now deal heavy continuous damage.
While Paradise Lost is being primed, lightning steadily falls.

rules.nameZh: 敌人的能力值UP
rules.descriptionZh: 别西卜的HP+170% / 昏厥槽+110%
rules.descriptionEn: Beelzebub: HP +170% / Stun Gauge +110%

rules.nameZh: 更容易从场地跌落
rules.nameEn: Easier to fall off or get knocked off the stage
rules.descriptionZh:
任务开始时场地边缘的部分结界消失
别西卜攻击的击飞效果获得强化
rules.descriptionEn:
Quest begins with parts of the stage's outer edge exposed.
Beelzebub's attacks deal more knockback.

rules.nameZh: 从场地跌落时获得最大HP减少效果
rules.nameEn: Falling off the stage reduces max HP
rules.descriptionZh:
每次从场地跌落
都会被赋予[最大HP减少]（永久/最大Lv5）
效果无法通过全体净化等手段解除
rules.descriptionEn:
Upon falling from the stage, you gain a permanent lvl of
Max HP↓  (max lvl 5). It can't be removed.

rules.nameZh: 别西卜的光弹攻击获得强化
rules.descriptionZh:
别西卜的光弹攻击变得更加猛烈
且会同时使用红黄两种光弹
rules.descriptionEn:
Beelzebub's light orb projectiles are more powerful.
A mix of red and yellow orbs can now be fired together.

rules.nameZh: 角色每次被束缚都会使别西卜获得强化
rules.descriptionZh:
己方每次被束缚
别西卜都会获得[混沌转换]（永久/最大Lv5）
Lv每级效果量：别西卜的攻击力+4%
每次使别西卜陷入硬直可降低Lv1
rules.descriptionEn:
Whenever Beelzebub inflicts Bound, he gains a permanent lvl
of Chaos Shift  (max lvl 5). While in effect, he gains
ATK +4% per effect lvl.
Causing Beelzebub to flinch lowers the lvl by 1.

rules.nameZh: 敌人的能力值UP
rules.descriptionZh:
天元泽卡定榫的HP+160% / 攻击力+30% / 昏厥槽+100%
各属性至理的HP+200% / 攻击力+20% / 昏厥槽+100%
天元回响和理天之像的HP+200% / 攻击力+30%
天元回响的昏厥槽+100%
理天之像的昏厥槽+100%
rules.descriptionEn:
Omnis Zegalith: HP +160% / ATK +30% / Stun Gauge +100%
Each Elemental Law: HP +200% / ATK +20% / Stun Gauge +100%
Logos Echo / Logos Empyreal: HP +200% / ATK +30%
Logos Echo: Stun Gauge +100%
Logos Empyreal: Stun Gauge +100%

rules.nameZh: 任务开始时消耗部分危机槽
rules.nameEn: Enter battle with less critical gauge
rules.descriptionZh: 任务开始时大幅消耗危机槽
rules.descriptionEn: Starts the quest with a greatly depleted critical gauge.

rules.nameZh: 根据战况回复危机槽
rules.descriptionZh:
任务中根据通过各类难关所用时间回复危机槽
所用时间越短回复量越高
rules.descriptionEn:
Critical gauge is restored based on how quickly various
trials during the quest are overcome.

rules.nameZh: 天元泽卡定榫的攻击变得更加猛烈
rules.nameEn: Omnis Zegalith attacks are more devastating
rules.descriptionZh:
天元泽卡定榫的攻击变得更加猛烈
穹龙试炼的规定时间缩短
各属性至理在场时天元泽卡定榫也会进行攻击
rules.descriptionEn:
Omnis Zegalith's attacks are enhanced, and Sky Dragons' Trial
channels faster. Omnis Zegalith now may attack during
trials against elemental laws.

rules.nameZh: 天元回响和理天之像的攻击变得更加猛烈
rules.descriptionZh: 天元回响和理天之像的攻击变得更加猛烈
rules.descriptionEn: Logos Echo and Logos Empyreal attacks are enhanced.

interpretation: Effect id/value pairs are raw table parameters. Only localized placeholders are substituted; unknown field semantics remain unnamed.
